style: Glam cabaret and theatrical brass band rock, [HARMONY SYSTEM] barbershop voice leading with bitonal chromatic side-steps and suspended dominant fields, [MELODIC SYSTEM] chromatic cabaret patter opening into soaring sustained melisma, [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] waltz pulse invaded by syncopated sixteenth-note disco four-on-the-floor accents, [TIMBRE SYSTEM] fuzz guitar, grand piano, glockenspiel, booming brass, and tambourine with spring reverb, [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] theatrical overstatement delivered with absolute deadpan manic intensity, [ANCHOR] a pulsing grand piano chord that remains fixed while all surrounding meter fractures, operators: hold piano chord fixed while brass migrates; compress vocal rhythm while stretching ensemble harmony; make cabaret piano behave like a laser; preserve tambourine pulse while destabilizing rhythm; force slow waltz and fast disco to coexist; return to piano anchor in a more mutated form, 982 characters
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Spoken through megaphones]
Attention all dimensions, the geometry is leaking.
[Orchestral hit, brass blare]

[Verse 1]
[Fast cabaret patter, frantic piano, galloping tambourine]
Rhombic dodecahedron rolling down the astral plane,
A twelve-faced tesseract operating my brain!
It's a biblically accurate angel made of light,
Spinning through dimensions in the middle of the night!
With fifty pairs of sparkling eyes and iridescent wheels,
Look at how the sacred math completely shifts and peels!

[Pre-Chorus]
[Swelling strings, sudden silent gap]
Wait—is that a triangle or a theological threat?
[Drop beat, distorted bass pulse]

[Chorus]
[Massed gospel-cabaret choir, soaring melismatic high notes]
Glitter on the Merkaba, spinning in the sky,
Rainbow body aura flying right on by!
Tripping balls across the infinite divine decree,
Geometric angels having tea with you and me!
Prismatic sparkly wings of pure velocity,
Dancing through the madness with ferocious glee!

[Verse 2]
[Hocketed vocal fragments, bouncy piano, walking bassline]
Angle A is literally orange juice.
Causal debt is dripping from the hypotenuse.
Every time the tesseract unfolds a fold,
Unrealized alternatives turn into gold!
We are seeing sounds and we are tasting light,
Floating past the stars on a mathematical kite!

[Bridge]
[Slow waltz time, weeping brass, theatrical operatic vibrato]
O sacred geometry, forgive our earthly sin,
As the inner rings begin to spin within...
[Acceleration ramp]
Faster now, faster now, collapse the space between!
The strangest heavenly host that man has ever seen!

[Guitar Solo]
[Fuzz guitar, wild glissando, frantic disco beat]

[Chorus]
[Explosive volume, massed choir, full instrumentation]
Glitter on the Merkaba, spinning in the sky,
Rainbow body aura flying right on by!
Tripping balls across the infinite divine decree,
Geometric angels having tea with you and me!
Prismatic sparkly wings of pure velocity,
Dancing through the madness with ferocious glee!

[Outro]
[Decrescendo, solo piano, whispered nonsense vocables]
Zip-zop, dodecahedron drop...
The astral plane will never stop...
[Single lingering piano chord]
[Silence]
caption: A theatrical glam-cabaret collision between a tesseract and a biblically accurate angel, operating under identity accidents and lossy sensory compression. Driven by frantic piano, soaring choir, brass, and disco-waltz time warps.
